newsitem.title: USA: Auto sales in U.S. off 11.4 pct June 21-30 - CNW.
newsitem.headline: Auto sales in U.S. off 11.4 pct June 21-30 - CNW.

text.p: Auto sales in the United States fell 11.4 percent in the 10 days June 21-30 compared with the same period a year ago, according to a report by CNW Marketing/Research.
During the survey period, sales of domestic vehicles slumped 11.3 percent, and U.S. sales of imports fell 12.6 percent.
Domestic car sales fell 13.8 percent, to 283,568 from 328,796, CNW said. Domestic truck sales fell 8.0 percent, to 232,568 from 252,844, it said.
Import car sales declined 12.3 percent to 63,866, and import truck sales fell 14.2 percent to 9,568, the report said.
Year-to-date, vehicle sales in the United States reached 7,751,297, off 2.7 percent from the same period of 1996, according to CNW.
